obligation_records.statement: UI_Command_Catalog mixes shell and object-targeting navigation in the same layout/UI-state bucket; Crosswalk lacks a primitive for route-target navigation; Contracts_V0 lacks canonical route-target/OpenSubject, so payloads stay ad hoc.
obligation_records.evidence_ledger_excerpt:
`UI_Command_Catalog.md` currently mixes shell commands and object-targeting navigation commands in the same "layout/UI state only" bucket
- `Crosswalk.md` still names `Primitive:UICommand` and `Primitive:DocumentPane`, but it has no primitive boundary for route-target navigation
- `Contracts_V0.md` still has no canonical route-target/open-subject contract
